title: AwakenLife
description: A hardcore survival challenge combining the Awaken and LifeSteal SMP mechanics!
body: Experience the ultimate hardcore challenge with AwakenLife! This plugin merges the unforgiving nature of the Awaken SMP with the health-stealing mechanics of LifeSteal. If a player kills you, you're banned from the server until another player revives you by placing your head. Die to natural causes, and you'll lose a heart permanently. Craft hearts to regain your life, but if you lose them all, you'll need a special revive stone to be brought back. This plugin is highly customizable and adds a thrilling twist to survival gameplay.
